value.title: Phase 1: complete Builder team lifecycle
value.summary: One cohesive delivery phase with a PM contract baseline, six isolated coder units and PM-owned public composition/proof; the actual final blind run follows committed product review.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Execute the reviewed guide, not a one-coder-per-ceremony split. Unit completion is partial evidence; only composed observable behavior plus independent review satisfies the product acceptance criteria.

value.title: Seal shared interfaces and evidence contracts
value.success: Freeze the settled shared interfaces, public command/record contracts and independently executable fixtures before fan-out.
value.notes: Guide unit ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0001; PM-owned wave 0. The creation/adoption ownership boundary is resolved; executable baseline proof and independent review remain required.

value.title: Implement guide validation and baseline readiness
value.success: Load/author the separate implementation guide; prove graph/fence/coverage structure and seal/verify shared contract evidence. Keep human architectural judgement distinct from deterministic readiness.
value.notes: Guide unit ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0002; wave 1. Reject empty units/proof/contracts/capability maps, unknown/cyclic dependencies, backward waves, read-owner gaps, overlapping write fences and missing observable AC owners. A digest or SHA drift invalidates the seal and any dependent dispatch.

value.title: Implement owned workspace allocation and reclamation
value.success: Reserve and initialize portable workspaces with provenance, stage missing packaged DD schemas without clobbering customization, adopt externally created resources honestly and reclaim only safe owned resources after preservation.
value.notes: Guide unit ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0003; wave 1. Harness-owned creation and external-only adoption are now authorized by the accepted scope. Reservation must precede Git mutation, use exclusive creation in shared-repository storage, scan all existing/sibling allocations and never reuse tombstones. Reject escaping paths, existing targets, dirty/unpushed/unmerged work, unowned resources and a sole archive inside the resource being removed. Full clones are supported isolated working directories, not .git rewrites.

value.title: Implement role settings and acknowledged dispatch
value.success: Resolve role settings with provenance, prepare immutable scope packets, provision through the injected workspace operation, invoke the declared runtime and release work only after observed readiness and exact packet acknowledgement.
value.notes: Guide unit ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0004; wave 1. Read the existing settings loader; do not create a parallel settings parser, mutate global configuration or treat descriptor/requested model values as actual inference evidence. Local peer clones avoid remote publication. A spawn accepted by tmux is not a ready peer. No shell or main-then-cd fallback.

value.title: Implement canonical lifecycle and composition evidence
value.success: Advance the existing flow only from valid evidence, compose accepted unit commits on the plan branch, bind review to the composed artifact and complete post-flight/archive without inventing shipping authorization.
value.notes: Guide unit ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0005; wave 1. Fail red or stale evidence honestly, preserve conflict state, never mutate main or accept out-of-fence commits, and reject unresolved material findings. An archive must survive later workspace removal; stage preservation outside the removable root and verify content/references before any tidy call.

value.title: Update Builder routing templates and worked examples
value.success: Cleanly separate product planning from implementation guidance throughout the existing Builder skill and supply executable good/bad architecture examples, packets/settings and preservation cases.
value.notes: Guide unit ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0006; wave 1. Update registry/router/core planning, tasks, implementation, review, post-flight, ship, flight-plan schema/template, source templates and every consumer together. Coordinate the in-flight structured-backpressure change; do not restore Markdown-only truth or edit deployed home-directory skills. Never claim a solo fallback executed requested cross-model review.

value.title: Compose public capabilities and prove complete delivery
value.success: Own the CLI and package composition root, expose every accepted capability, integrate completed units, run the real surface/consumer smoke and preserve complete manual dogfood and independent review evidence.
value.notes: Guide unit ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0007; wave 2. Only the PM integrates. Run final validation once the composition is stable; reviewers receive committed SHA plus immutable plan/guide hashes. No remote push/PR/merge or unsafe teardown is implicit in completion.

value.title: Extend evaluator for blind Builder team delivery
value.success: Extend the existing flow-eval evaluator and its thin run router for a blind DD-native Builder-team Markdown-to-PDF delivery. Keep the scorer architecture; own native evidence acquisition, subject/base binding, meaningful team/artifact checks and the isolated task fixture, not Builder lifecycle or telemetry capture.
value.notes: Guide unit ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0008; wave 1. Tests defend false-positive refusal and honest partial native evidence; the PM-owned final blind run is outside this phase task.

tk-0001.assertion: The reviewed shared guide/packet/receipt interfaces and typed DD schemas are committed, with existing injected fake adapters and no unit-implementation imports.
The shared serialization/ownership/argv contract fixture is runnable and its real passing proof is bound to the observed contract-baseline SHA and file digests.
Owner and workspace kind are distinct in the allocation contract; externally owned resources cannot be silently promoted to owned or reaped.
Requested model/effort, observed runtime configuration and unverified provider identity have distinct fields and tested serialization; omitted effort is not fabricated.

tk-0002.assertion: A valid non-empty guide loads/renders with SRP units, declared write/read ownership, executable proof links and a justified solo/coders decision.
Behavior tests reject vacuous guides, unknown/cyclic dependencies, invalid waves, ownership conflicts and an AC whose internal producer exists but observable capability has no owner.
Sealing runs required proof against an observed commit and declared digests; changed, missing or red baseline evidence deterministically blocks dispatch readiness.

tk-0003.assertion: Concurrent real/fake harness-owned allocation scenarios reserve distinct ordinals before branch/workspace mutation and preserve resumable reservations/tombstones; collisions and escaping paths never clobber existing work.
tk-0003.note: Allocation authority is resolved; implementation and proof are still outstanding.

tk-0003.assertion: Fresh initialization stages missing packaged schemas and creates the numbered plan/guide/templates/canonical flow without a global install or destructive retry.
Adoption records observed owner/kind/root/branch/base/ordinal/actor facts; an external resource is never claimed, reallocated or automatically removed.

Teardown verifies clean/merged/preserved owned state and a surviving archive outside the removable root; dirty, unpushed, unowned, ambiguous or sole-copy cases refuse and partial failure resumes safely.
The scaffold seeds assets/backpressure.dd.json and plan meta.backpressure without overwriting existing survey data or claiming proof was run.

tk-0004.assertion: Behavior tests prove repo < guide < explicit role-setting precedence, settings provenance, omitted effort and a truthful separation of requested versus observed runtime configuration.

Dispatch uses the injected workspace/readiness boundary, publishes a resolvable immutable fence packet and refuses work release until registered peer/root readiness plus exact nonce/packet/baseline acknowledgement match; unsupported runtime/model/root cases fail explicitly.

tk-0005.assertion: Stage advancement uses the existing canonical flow kernel and rejects due unreceipted chores, failed DD gates, stale evidence and out-of-fence completion; no team-local phase field is advanced.

Composition checks unit fences and bases, integrates committed units in dependency order on the plan branch, records the actual composed SHA and runs the guide proof; conflicts/red proof remain visible and main is untouched.
Review binds verdict and findings to the composed SHA plus plan/guide hashes; a changed artifact or unresolved material finding blocks closure even when unit tests passed.
Close-out requires actual Builder/harness/post-flight evidence, archives the complete plan, re-anchors flow links and verifies a surviving copy before tidy, without inventing shipping authorization.

tk-0006.assertion: The tracked Builder registry/router/core and all stage/flight-plan consumers use distinct plan versus implementation guide and one canonical lifecycle; updated harness seams use the canonical backpressure DD source and completed historical plans remain readable.

The shipped examples actually execute injected services and explicit composition, demonstrate good/bad independence and AC coverage, and supply coherent role/packet/acknowledgement/review/preservation examples without placeholder implementations.

Both tracked skills and all affected stage/templates invoke local ddocs for the canonical survey, actual approach/proof selection, AC pressure/proven_by and assertion pressure links; no legacy Markdown-only truth or removed harness dd command is taught.

tk-0007.assertion: At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0001: The packaged CLI exposes the Builder lifecycle through discoverable help and instructions with the existing JSON envelope/exit conventions; missing prerequisites, name collisions and unsupported runtime capabilities are explicit rather than silent success.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0002: New workspace creation atomically reserves the next ordinal against the shared repository and sibling worktrees, records a resumable allocation before Git mutation, never reuses closed reservations, and refuses conflicting or escaping paths without clobbering existing work.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0003: A successful initialization creates the branch, worktree, correctly numbered plan folder, separate implementation-guide source, packet/model-setting templates and complete canonical Builder flow with required harness chores; retries preserve existing content.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0004: Allocation metadata is a deterministic document with explicit owner, worktree, branch, base SHA, ordinal, actor and lifecycle/tombstone state; externally created worktrees are recorded as externally owned and are never silently reallocated or reaped.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0005: The implementation guide has a declared schema and generated Markdown face, with non-empty SRP responsibilities, exact write/read ownership, settled contracts, dependencies/waves, per-unit proof, composition ownership and a justified solo-or-coders decision.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0006: Readiness rejects empty/vacuous guides, unknown or cyclic dependencies, unresolved ownership collisions, missing contract/proof declarations and ACs with no observable capability owner; architectural judgement is reported separately from structural proof.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0007: The contracts stage binds declared shared interfaces, fixtures and required proof to an observed baseline commit/digest, and dispatch refuses changed or absent baseline evidence rather than relying on a status flag.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0008: Repository role defaults and plan/dispatch overrides have documented precedence for harness, model and effort, are recorded with the run, and preserve the distinction between requested launch settings and observed/acknowledged runtime identity.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0009: Dispatch provisions each coder in its own isolated Git checkout (linked worktree or full clone, with kind recorded) at the approved baseline, publishes a scoped packet with resolvable inputs, invokes the declared runtime, records its identity/readiness, and refuses work release until nonce/packet-hash acknowledgement matches the dispatched contract.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-000a: Builder stage advancement uses the existing flow state/mutation kernel and refuses unmet DD gates, required harness chores without receipts, missing or stale evidence and unit completion claims outside the declared fence.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-000b: The PM composes completed units in dependency order on the plan branch, records the composed SHA and runs the guide-named integration proof against that artifact; conflicts or red proof leave an explicit incomplete state and do not mutate main.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-000c: Review records name the composed SHA and exact plan/guide basis; a changed SHA, missing verdict, unresolved material findings or unsupported closure claim prevents review completion, including when unit checks were green.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-000d: Close-out verifies required Builder and engineering-harness lifecycle evidence, produces/validates the post-flight record, archives the whole plan folder and re-anchors flow/document references without treating optional shipping as automatically authorized.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-000e: Teardown preserves required WIP/reports/observations and a verifiable surviving archive before removal, refuses unowned/dirty/unpushed/unmerged or ambiguous resources by default, is resumable after partial failure and retains allocation tombstones.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-000f: Tracked Builder source separates plan and implementation-guide stages and updates registry, routing, templates, tasks/implement/review/post-flight/ship consumers consistently, with capability checks and no second independently advanced flow; completed historical plans retain their existing read path.

At the committed composition, the actual public/packed surface and corresponding recorded proof establish ac-0010: The shipped skill/docs include runnable architecture-enabled good and bad decomposition examples, injectable service contracts, dependency waves, AC-to-capability coverage, model settings, packet acknowledgement, composition/review proof and preservation/refusal cases.

The implementation-owned portion of ac-0011 is proven: deterministic behavior tests and disposable real-Git/packed-consumer smoke pass, and an immutable composed SHA with plan/guide inputs and receipts is prepared for independent review. Actual review and complete manual close-out remain later lifecycle evidence, not prerequisites for entering those stages.
tk-0007.note: Partial satisfaction only; do not create a temporal cycle by requiring review/post-flight completion to leave implementation.

tk-0007.assertion: The documented ddocs survey/AC/assertion/evidence recipe is executed through the real CLI and packed consumer, and typed links plus generated views validate.

tk-0008.assertion: The existing evaluator rejects inherited subject plans, wrong base/plan bindings and nonempty but unresolved pressure/satisfies/proof links; semantic checks delegate to local ddocs and the existing complete plan validator rather than a second link interpreter.

Explicit native OMP evidence uses the public rs native-session identity and verified Flowspace source, bounded windows of at most 200 each side, complete cutoff coverage and honest timestamps. Unsupported segments, checks, refusals, usage or opaque execution remain unknown; no buffer label or synthetic vendor environment is used.

Team evidence binds declared units, actual distinct peer/root identities, frozen contract/packet hashes, nonce acknowledgements, nonempty implementation commits and the composed review SHA. Reviewer-only or checker-only padding, shared roots, stale acknowledgements and detached reviews cannot satisfy implementation fan-out.

The new versioned scenario and thin run router expose the task and Builder method mandate without rubric, stage choreography or prescribed unit boundaries. A runnable local packaged-consumer fixture exposes delivered skills/CLI assets without global installs or hidden evaluation artifacts.

Behavioral regression controls exercise missing/partial native evidence, pagination boundaries, inherited artifacts, invalid links, stale binding and missing output; the evaluator test command fails when it collects zero tests. Reports preserve source/provenance and keep process evidence separate from independently exercised capability.

sections.name: goals
value: Keep every unit independently implementable against frozen injected contracts.
Expose and prove every accepted capability through the actual packaged CLI and source Builder workflow.
Preserve the complete manual Builder/harness record, archive and owned-resource safety even while shipping awaits authorization.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No source changes to pij, Flowspace or deployed/global skills.
No silent model/root fallback, new competing flow state, remote push/PR/merge or unowned resource removal.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Use ../../research-dossier.md and ../../impl-guide.dd.json; these preserve the prior-art handoff and the exact delivery/ownership contracts.

value.approach: Hybrid: test-first for state transitions, readiness predicates, allocation/preservation and failure paths; direct behavioral smoke for the public CLI.
value.rationale: The risk is false success or data loss, not syntax; injected fakes prove ordering/refusals and disposable real Git repositories prove the user-facing lifecycle.
value.focus_areas: Non-vacuity; atomic ordinal reservation; path containment; owner checks; stale evidence; contract drift; pending acknowledgements; composition and review SHA binding; required lifecycle receipts; archive preservation and teardown refusal.
value.excluded: No timing thresholds, mocked internal modules, source-text tests as behavioral proof, or live shared-tree validation by concurrent coders.
value.mock_usage: Existing injected port fakes and real isolated fixtures only; no vi.mock/vi.spyOn/monkey-patching.

value.location: Tracked skills/builder and skills/eng-harness-flow source, bundled harness docs/instructions, schema/template examples, and this plan assets directory.
value.rationale: One canonical method and one command surface; examples demonstrate injectable services, good/bad splits, dependency waves, AC ownership and safe closure, while the detailed run log preserves the manual dogfood evidence.

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value: Portable allocation is harness-owned; manual and adopted resources remain external. OMP peers use full local clones, isolated dependencies and actual native-root/message canaries. Typed backpressure is ../../backpressure.dd.json. Source-level design does not substitute for baseline, runtime or product proof.
